description: The bar chart illustrates the popularity of three categories—Movies, Songs, and Basketball—across three AI models: Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT, with popularity values represented on a linear vertical axis ranging from 20 to 220 in increments of 20. The horizontal axis displays the three categories, and within each category, three bars are stacked to represent different conditions: 'Acc=0 & GT Ans' (mesh pattern), 'Acc=0 & Gene Ans' (diagonal stripes), and 'Acc=1 & GT Ans' (solid fill). Each model is color-coded: Llama3 in blue, Qwen2 in red, and ChatGPT in yellow. For Movies, the total popularity across all conditions is relatively low, with values ranging from approximately 25 to 50, and ChatGPT showing the lowest total. In Songs, popularity increases, with values ranging from about 50 to 80, and Llama3 achieving the highest total. In Basketball, popularity rises significantly, with values spanning from roughly 95 to 220, and ChatGPT reaching the maximum observed popularity of approximately 220. The bars are grouped by category without any sorting within groups, and no additional visual emphasis is applied. A legend in the top-left corner clarifies the model-color and condition-pattern associations.
